title: Classic Paella Recipe
description: A traditional Spanish dish from the Valencia region, known for its saffron-infused rice, savory seafood, and smoky chorizo.
instructions: Heat oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chorizo and cook until browned, about 2-3 minutes. Remove from pan.
Add onion and bell pepper and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes.
Add dates, olives, and cooked chorizo.
Stir in chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until rice is tender.
Fluff with a fork and serve immediately.
